material_type: Sampling dates for all Riftia tissue samples for proteomics, transcriptomics, and transmission electron microscopy (TEM) are summarized in Table S1e in the supplemental material.
sample_source: Riftia specimens were collected by the human occupied vehicle Alvin or the remotely operated vehicle Jason in approximately 2,500-m water depth.
species: Therefore, we studied the deep-sea Riftia pachyptila symbiosis, a model association in which the tubeworm host is associated with only one phylotype of endosymbiotic bacteria and completely depends on this sulfur-oxidizing symbiont for nutrition.
tissue: For metaproteomics analysis, we used three biological replicates per tissue (trophosome, vestimentum, and plume) and condition (specimens with S-rich and S-depleted trophosomes), which resulted in a total of 18 samples.
